args.description: 读取 ffmpeg-utils skill 定义文件
执行 ffmpeg-utils skill 测试命令
args.command:
mkdir -p /mnt/user-data/outputs/ffmpeg-utils/artifacts
python /mnt/skills/custom/ffmpeg-utils/scripts/run.py --operation segment --input-path /mnt/datasets/Vedio-demo/Trafic.mp4 --start-time 1 --duration 2 --output-path /mnt/user-data/outputs/ffmpeg-utils/artifacts/segment.mp4 --output /mnt/user-data/outputs/ffmpeg-utils/segment_result.json
python /mnt/skills/custom/ffmpeg-utils/scripts/run.py --operation keyframe --input-path /mnt/datasets/Vedio-demo/Trafic.mp4 --timestamp 1 --output-path /mnt/user-data/outputs/ffmpeg-utils/artifacts/keyframe.jpg --output /mnt/user-data/outputs/ffmpeg-utils/keyframe_result.json
python - <<'PY'
import json
segment = json.load(open('/mnt/user-data/outputs/ffmpeg-utils/segment_result.json'))
keyframe = json.load(open('/mnt/user-data/outputs/ffmpeg-utils/keyframe_result.json'))
json.dump({"skill":"ffmpeg-utils","version":"1.0.0","status":"success" if segment.get("status") == "success" and keyframe.get("status") == "success" else "failed","data":{"segment":segment,"keyframe":keyframe}}, open('/mnt/user-data/outputs/ffmpeg-utils/result.json','w'), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
PY
